raw_response: BNY Mellon described the growth in its ETF servicing business as validating multiyear investments into these platforms, noting that ETF assets under custody (AUCA) were up over 60% year-over-year with inflows on their platform outpacing the market. The company also highlighted a "particular strength" in ETF and alternative servicing and noted the development of new capabilities such as a NextGen ETF servicing platform.
